Technical daily maintenance manual – “Synthetic Summit”
________________


1. Ceiling lights
   * Turn on/off via remote control.

   2. Artwork 17 “Lex”
   * If the screen freezes or does not show the artwork:
   1. Unplug the Raspberry Pi behind the screen.
   2. Turn the screen on again.
   3. Fetch mouse from artwork 6 “syntheticism.org” and press “Reload” on the screen.
   * Why: Restart eliminates software errors.

      3. Artwork 1 (Radio Palme)
      * Open the radio at the back.
      * Take out iPhone, click once, start “Radio Palme” on Spotify.
      * Put the phone back, close the radio.
      * Why: The soundtrack resumes.

         4. Artwork 10 “Synthetic Summit Simulator”
         * Unplug the Raspberry Pi under the keyboard console every morning, wait for restart.
         * Fetch mouse from artwork 6. Attach it to Pi (hung on a screw).
         * Select user profile “Citizen Cyborg” (icon with an elderly man).
         * Click in chat field, place mouse at bottom right (out of view), remove mouse and return it to artwork 6.
         * Why: Chat surface is ready.

            5. Artwork 5 “Playtest for broad listening”
            * Behind the curtain: Press the green button. See if “Listening” is projected.
            * If nothing happens:
            1. Fetch mouse from artwork 6.
            2. Insert into Pi under table (with lights and instructions).
            3. Move cursor to upper left icon (cursor = hand), turn mouse over (held).
            4. Pull out USB plug, press green button again.
            * Why: Allows start-up if software hangs.

               6. In case of problems
               * Call/SMS Asker ([████]).
